description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Yahalegama, Nuwaragampalatha- East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District   - Cad. Map No.  110192
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (all listed as "The State"), and land classification information. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
